#ifndef ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_TOOLCHAIN_GCC_H_
#define ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_TOOLCHAIN_GCC_H_


#include <zephyr/toolchain/common.h>

#if !defined(__ASSEMBLER__)

#include <stddef.h>

/*
 * The gcc-version.h header is not available before gcc 5.0.0.
 * The __GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__ is not available before gcc 3.0.0.
 */
#if __GNUC__ >= 5
#include <gcc-version.h>
#endif

#ifndef __GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__
#define __GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__ 0
#endif

#define GCC_VERSION (__GNUC__ * 10000 \
		   + __GNUC_MINOR__ * 100 \
		   + __GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__)

#if (GCC_VERSION < 40800)
#error "Zephyr requires GCC 4.8.0 or higher"
#endif

#undef __in_section
#define __in_section(sect) __attribute__((section("." #sect)))

#undef __in_section_unique
#define __in_section_unique(sect) __attribute__((section("." #sect "." __FILE__ "." __func__ "." STRINGIFY(__LINE__))))

#define __in_section_named(sect) __attribute__((section(sect)))

#define __no_optimization __attribute__((optimize("-O0")))
#define __no_inline __attribute__((noinline))
#define __used __attribute__((__used__))
#define __unused __attribute__((__unused__))
#define __maybe_unused __attribute__((__unused__))
#define __deprecated __attribute__((deprecated))
#define __fallthrough __attribute__((fallthrough))

#define Z_INTERNAL_DEPRECATED_MACRO_CAT(a, b) a##b
#define Z_INTERNAL_DEPRECATED_MACRO_CAT2(a, b) Z_INTERNAL_DEPRECATED_MACRO_CAT(a, b)
#define Z_INTERNAL_DEPRECATED_MACRO_UNIQUE_NAME(prefix) \
	Z_INTERNAL_DEPRECATED_MACRO_CAT2(prefix, __COUNTER__)

#if defined(CONFIG_WARN_DEPRECATED) && !defined(__DEPRECATE_MACROS)

#define __DEPRECATED_MACRO(macro, msg) \
	__DEPRECATED_MACRO_NAMED(STRINGIFY(macro), macro, msg)

/* The use of a statement expression is deliberate.
 *
 * 1. It allows the macro to be used in any context where an expression is
 *    valid, and not just as a standalone statement.
 * 2. It creates a new scope for the static inline function.
 *
 * The use of a static inline function is also deliberate.
 *
 * 1. It allows the compiler to issue a warning when the macro is used.
 * 2. It is defined as static inline so that the compiler can optimize it away.
 *
 * The use of __COUNTER__ is to ensure that the function name is unique, which
 * is necessary to avoid name clashes when the macro is used multiple times
 * in the same scope.
 *
 * The use of if (false) is to suppress the unused warning for the macro
 * parameter. When `macro` is a function-like macro, (void)macro results in a
 * call to the macro with no arguments, which is often a compilation error.
 * The if (false) block is never executed, but the compiler still parses it
 * and sees that the macro is "used".
 */
#define __DEPRECATED_MACRO_NAMED(name, macro, msg) \
	({ \
		__attribute__((deprecated(msg " (" #name ")"))) \
		static inline void Z_INTERNAL_DEPRECATED_MACRO_UNIQUE_NAME(_deprecated_macro_)(void) {}; \
		if (false) { \
			(void)Z_INTERNAL_DEPRECATED_MACRO_UNIQUE_NAME(_deprecated_macro_); \
			(void)macro; \
		} \
		macro; \
	})

#else /* !CONFIG_WARN_DEPRECATED || __DEPRECATE_MACROS */

#define __DEPRECATED_MACRO(macro, msg) macro
#define __DEPRECATED_MACRO_NAMED(name, macro, msg) macro

#endif /* CONFIG_WARN_DEPRECATED && !__DEPRECATE_MACROS */

#define __weak __attribute__((__weak__))
#define __packed __attribute__((__packed__))
#define __aligned(x) __attribute__((__aligned__(x)))
#define __printf_like(f, a)   __attribute__((format(printf, f, a)))
#define __scanf_like(f, a)   __attribute__((format(scanf, f, a)))

#define ARG_UNUSED(x) (void)(x)

/*
 * These macros are used to suppress "-Wunused-parameter" warnings, but only
 * if the toolchain supports the __unused attribute.
 */
#define UNUSED_PARAM(x) x __maybe_unused
#define UNUSED_PARAMS(...) FOR_EACH(UNUSED_PARAM, (,), __VA_ARGS__)

#define __no_return __attribute__((__noreturn__))

#define __ramfunc __in_section(ramfunc)

#define __rom __in_section(romfunc)

#define __noret __no_return

#define __weak_func __weak

#define __kernel __in_section(kernel)

#define __user

#define __force_inline inline __attribute__((always_inline))

#define __nocast

#define __subsystem

#if defined(CONFIG_STACK_CANARIES)
#define __stack_no_check __attribute__((no_stack_protector))
#else
#define __stack_no_check
#endif

#define popcount(x) __builtin_popcount(x)

#include <zephyr/toolchain/gcc_builtin.h>

#endif /* !__ASSEMBLER__ */

#endif /* ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_TOOLCHAIN_GCC_H_ */
